question: For this ClawSweeper-authored forward-port, should maintainers require fresh real behavior/release-gate proof after repair, waive it with a proof override, or pause/close the replacement?
rationale: The patch has a mechanical repair path, but the existing bot status explicitly leaves proof sufficiency to maintainer intent rather than contributor follow-up.

options.title: Repair then prove
options.body: Repair the branch and capture focused real behavior or release-gate proof for the repaired head before merge.

options.title: Override proof gate
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly waive the bot proof gate if focused validation plus CI is sufficient for this forward-port.

options.title: Pause or close replacement
options.body: If the forward-port is no longer worth carrying through conflicts, pause or close it and leave current main as-is.

recommendation.title: Repair then prove
recommendation.body: Repair the branch and capture focused real behavior or release-gate proof for the repaired head before merge.
